name: unifi-protect
description: UniFi Protect MCP server — manage security cameras, NVR, recordings, and smart detections

host.title: Host
host.description: UniFi Protect console or NVR IP address or hostname

username.title: Username
username.description: Local account username for session authentication

password_file.title: Password file
password_file.description: Absolute path to a file that holds the password. Set one password source only

password_command.title: Password command
password_command.description: Absolute argv, run without a shell, that prints the password. Set one password source only

password.title: Password
password.description: Password stored in the system keychain. Prefer a password file or command. Set one password source only

api_key_file.title: API key file
api_key_file.description: Absolute path to a file that holds the API key. Set one API key source only

api_key_command.title: API key command
api_key_command.description: Absolute argv, run without a shell, that prints the API key. Set one API key source only

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: API key stored in the system keychain. Prefer an API key file or command. Set one API key source only

policy_create.title: Allow create
policy_create.description: Allow tools that create objects. Off keeps the server read-only for creation

policy_update.title: Allow update
policy_update.description: Allow tools that change objects. Off keeps the server read-only for changes

policy_delete.title: Allow delete
policy_delete.description: Allow tools that delete, block, reboot or revoke. Off keeps them disabled

permission_mode.title: Permission mode
permission_mode.description: confirm previews every mutation before it runs; bypass runs it immediately

auto_confirm.title: Auto-confirm (deprecated)
auto_confirm.description: Legacy switch equivalent to bypass permission mode. Leave off

registration_mode.title: Tool registration
registration_mode.description: lazy loads tools on demand; eager registers every tool; meta_only exposes only discovery tools
